propositions: The scheduled Reconcile Bridge GitHub Action fails on every run since 2026-08-15T02:39Z with ACLI JQL parse error 'project = LEG AND status != "Done"' because LEG does not exist in live REB Jira

The live tickets branch .bridge_state/projects.json was overwritten with rehearsal fixture keys LEG/ONE/TWO/ZERO (nonexistent in production Jira) instead of the canonical empty state {legacy_default: REB, projects: {}}

The story-1734 multi-project fan-out in fetcher._build_snapshot iterates every key in projects.json to build inbound queries; a single nonexistent key causes the entire reconciliation pass to abort with exit 1

The canonical intended state is {version: 1, legacy_default: REB, projects: {}} (from the ensure-registry seed); this restores the green-run behavior where an empty projects map causes the fan-out to fall back to the single configured project REB
bridge-state writes (.bridge_state/projects.json mutations) lack atomic locking, git commit, and publish semantics, enabling the ad-hoc hand-commits that introduced the corruption
